6b0222ed18ef8a2b.company_name: شركة امتداد الغذاء المبتكر لتقديم الوجبات
6b0222ed18ef8a2b.description: نبحث عن شيف حلويات مبدع وموهوب للانضمام إلى فريقنا. ستكون مسؤولاً عن إعداد وتقديم مجموعة متنوعة من الحلويات عالية الجودة التي تلبي توقعات عملائنا. إذا كنت شغوفًا بالحلويات ولديك خبرة في هذا المجال، ندعوك للتقديم. المهام والمسؤوليات: * ابتكار وتطوير وصفات حلويات جديدة وفريدة. * تحضير الحلويات اليومية وفقًا للمعايير المحددة. * ضمان جودة المكونات وسلامة الأغذية. * الحفاظ على نظافة وترتيب منطقة العمل.

6b101ab902bb547f.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة جزيرة سماء للازياء عن بائع للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور على بيع مجموعة من السلع والخدمات للعملاء، وتقديم معلومات شاملة حول المنتجات، بالإضافة إلى إدارة عمليات الدفع والمخزون. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية بيع مجموعة متنوعة من السلع والخدمات للعملاء. توفير معلومات دقيقة ومفصلة للعملاء حول المنتجات، استخداماتها، وأسعارها. مراقبة مستويات المخزون بشكل دوري والحفاظ على ترتيب المتجر. إصدار طلبات شراء المنتجات الجديدة والتعامل مع المنتجات الواردة. تولي جميع أمور الدفع وتلقي المدفوعات من العملاء. معالجة طلبات استبدال المنتجات والمرتجعات بما يتوافق مع السياسات المتبعة للشركة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال المبيعات أو خدمة العملاء. القدرة على التعامل مع العملاء وتقديم خدمة ممتازة. مهارات جيدة في التواصل والعرض. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق شركة جزيرة سماء للازياء في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يتطلب الدور التفاعل المباشر مع العملاء وإدارة المهام اليومية للمبيعات. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده ومناقشته خلال عملية المقابلة. نشجع المرشحين المهتمين والذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة على التقديم.

6b19e4268a141fcc.description: About the Role Al Tuwairqi Group is seeking a Storeman to join their team in Jeddah. This full-time position involves comprehensive material management within the warehouse, focusing on proper storage, identification, and maintaining a clean and organized environment. The role also includes assisting with material issuance and general administrative tasks for the stores department. Key Responsibilities Unload incoming materials, either manually or using a forklift when an operator is unavailable, based on material type. Transport materials from the receiving area to designated main warehouse locations as instructed by the Foreman/Storekeeper or Store Officer. Rearrange warehouse materials under the direct guidance of the Foreman/Storekeeper, storage operator, or store superiors as needed. Attach identification tags to materials in accordance with specified guidelines. Maintain cleanliness and housekeeping standards in all store offices, washrooms, kitchens, and warehouse storage areas. Prepare and serve tea for stores staff as required. Conduct daily housekeeping in the stores and yards, including storage areas, bins, locations, and offices, ensuring cleanliness and neatness. Utilize all safety methods and procedures while handling materials. Assist the Storekeeper in the process of issuing materials to users. Provide support to the Foreman or Storekeeper with general office work. Follow detailed work instructions provided separately for specific tasks. Aid in physical material issuance, receipts, and movements as advised by superiors within the stores department. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 0-1 year of experience in a similar role. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Jeddah, where the Storeman will operate within a warehouse and office environment, collaborating with the stores team and other departmental superiors.

6b1d436fdf9c1e96.description: About the Role Arctech is seeking a Machine Operator to join our team in Makkah, with operations spanning Jeddah and Makkah. This full-time position involves operating and monitoring production machinery within a steel manufacturing environment, ensuring both safe and efficient production processes. Role Overview The Machine Operator will be responsible for the direct operation of industrial machines critical to steel production. This role requires a commitment to maintaining high-quality output and adherence to established safety protocols. Candidates should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Operate and continuously monitor industrial machines utilized in steel production processes. Ensure all manufactured products consistently meet specified quality standards. Perform routine basic machine inspections and accurately report any identified issues or malfunctions. Strictly follow production schedules and adhere to all workplace safety procedures. Maintain a clean, organized, and safe working area at all times. Qualifications and Requirements High school diploma or a technical diploma is required. 5-10 years of previous experience in manufacturing or machine operation is preferred. Basic knowledge and understanding of industrial machinery. Ability to work effectively in various shift patterns as required by production demands. Good understanding and practical application of workplace safety procedures. Work Environment This full-time position is based in a steel manufacturing facility within the Makkah region, covering operations in Jeddah and Makkah. The role involves working directly with industrial machinery and requires adherence to strict safety protocols. Application Process Interested candidates who meet the specified requirements are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

6b4d6c4f59f6b0d3.description: About the Role Al Ghurair is seeking a Sales Executive to join their team in Makkah, with responsibilities covering both Jeddah and Makkah. This full-time position focuses on achieving targeted retail vehicle sales and profitability, including finance and insurance accessories. The role requires 2-5 years of experience in a relevant field. Key Responsibilities Execute the full sales process, facilitating the sale of new vehicles on behalf of the brand. Record and manage each customer enquiry within the dealer management system, ensuring proactive follow-up. Ensure a seamless customer transaction experience, meeting customer expectations in a timely manner. Understand and apply key performance indicators as provided by the line manager. Support the line manager in maximizing the profitability of each sale. Administrative Duties Adhere to the documented sales process, complying with all company and legal requirements. Assist customers in understanding the process and requirements for purchasing a new vehicle. Support the line manager in maintaining sales operations to desired standards in display and presentation. Comply with all Health, Safety, Security, and Environment (HSSE) standards. Required Experience Candidates should possess 2-5 years of experience in sales, preferably within the automotive or a related industry. A proven track record of achieving sales targets and managing customer relationships is essential. Work Environment and Location This is a full-time position based in Makkah, with responsibilities extending to Jeddah. The role involves direct customer interaction and adherence to established sales processes within a dynamic retail environment. Application Process The salary for this position will be disclosed during the interview process. Interested candidates are encouraged to apply to join the Al Ghurair team.

6bf9c1a3851c4b6f.description: About Boston Consulting Group (BCG) Boston Consulting Group (BCG) partners with leaders in business and society to address their most significant challenges and identify opportunities. Established in 1963 as a pioneer in business strategy, BCG now assists clients with comprehensive transformation, fostering complex change, enabling organizational growth, building competitive advantages, and driving bottom-line impact. The firm integrates digital and human capabilities through diverse, global teams that bring deep industry and functional expertise to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through management consulting, technology and design, corporate and digital ventures, and business purpose, operating with a collaborative model across the firm and client organizations to generate results. The Senior Associate Role BCG Saudi is seeking an Experienced Senior Associate to join its full-time team in Riyadh. This role involves contributing to client projects by collaborating in cross-functional teams, analyzing data, and developing actionable recommendations. The Senior Associate will be responsible for driving independent workstreams and communicating effectively with stakeholders to present results and facilitate implementation. Key Responsibilities Collaborate within cross-functional teams to address client challenges. Analyze data, formulate hypotheses, and develop actionable recommendations. Communicate effectively with stakeholders, presenting results and driving implementation. Drive independent workstreams, contributing to overall project success. Qualifications and Experience 2-5 years of relevant experience. Demonstrated ability to contribute to consulting projects. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Effective communication and presentation abilities. Career Development BCG is committed to the growth of its Senior Associates. The role includes access to training, coaching, and mentorship to further develop skills and expertise. Individuals will have opportunities to explore new horizons and expand their potential within the firm. Working at BCG Riyadh BCG has operated in the Middle East for nearly two decades. The Riyadh office, established in 2015, is central to Saudi Arabia's transformation. The team works with enterprise clients, public sector entities, and partners to achieve business goals and national visions. Joining BCG Riyadh offers the opportunity to participate in a national transformation program, combining global best practices with approaches drawn from Saudi culture and national objectives. Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable. BCG is an E-Verify Employer.

6bd72c22bbca981b.description: About Alghad College for Applied Medical Sciences Alghad College for Applied Medical Sciences is a leading private educational institution in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, established to address the growing demand for qualified national professionals in the health sector. The college operates branches in eight major regions and cities, including Riyadh, Jeddah, Madinah, Dammam, Tabuk, Buraidah, Najran, and Abha. It offers Bachelor's programs in applied medical sciences specializations, all accredited by the Ministry of Education. Job Summary Alghad College for Applied Medical Sciences is seeking a Librarian to join its team in Abha, 'Asir, Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time administrative position, requiring 48 hours of work per week. The role involves managing library resources, supporting academic departments, and enhancing the library experience for students and faculty. Key Responsibilities Activate and promote the use of Saudi Digital Library databases. Propose amendments to library administration guides, including policies and usage guidelines. Coordinate with scientific departments to determine the college's needs for references, books, periodicals, publications, and other learning resources. Manage and continuously update library systems, such as cataloging. Archive and organize audio, visual, readable, and other multimedia learning resources within the library. Prepare and circulate a monthly newsletter detailing new references and updates to the college community. Ensure the availability of necessary equipment for the protection of library contents. Organize internal and external borrowing operations. Coordinate with scientific departments to identify new developments in references, knowledge, and learning resources for library acquisition. Conduct training workshops for faculty members and students to introduce library components and their benefits. Survey opinions of students and faculty regarding the quality of library services. Propose library activities suitable for digitization. Required Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's degree in the required specialization. A minimum of two to five years of experience in the field of specialization. A grade of "Good" or higher in the Bachelor's degree. All university qualifications must be obtained through full-time study. Applicants must hold the specified academic degree from Saudi universities or universities recommended by the Ministry of Education (with proof of degree equivalency if applicable). Application Process Candidates must pass a scientific test and a personal interview. Salaries and job benefits will be determined through the job offer extended upon successful completion of the interview process.

6b8e249bec24983e.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة صلب تهامة لمنتجات الحديد عن مندوب مبيعات للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور إلى بناء علاقات قوية مع العملاء، ترويج المنتجات، وإتمام عمليات البيع بكفاءة. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة، وهو متاح بدوام كامل. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية جمع البيانات والمواصفات المتعلقة بالمنتجات (السلع والخدمات). إعداد قاعدة بيانات شاملة للعملاء الحاليين والمرتقبين، تتضمن بياناتهم وعناوينهم وأرقام هواتفهم. التواصل مع العملاء أو زيارتهم لترويج المنتجات وتقديم عروض البيع، مع استعراض مواصفاتها وميزتها التنافسية. التحقق من الأسعار ومنح الخصومات ضمن الصلاحيات المخولة. إتمام عملية البيع وتحرير الفواتير وتحصيل المبالغ المستحقة. متابعة العملاء وتحصيل ديونهم، وتسجيلها وتوثيقها، ثم توريدها للدائرة المالية. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية وتوثيقها وحفظها. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال المبيعات أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على بناء وإدارة علاقات العملاء. مهارات تواصل وعرض ممتازة. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات قوية في جمع البيانات وتحليلها. القدرة على التفاوض وإتمام الصفقات. مهارات تنظيمية وإدارة الوقت. القدرة على إعداد التقارير المهنية. بيئة العمل يعمل مندوب المبيعات بدوام كامل في مدينة جدة، ضمن منطقة مكة المكرمة. يتطلب الدور زيارات ميدانية للعملاء والتواصل المستمر معهم. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب غير معلن. سيتم تزويد المرشحين المختارين بتفاصيل إضافية خلال عملية التوظيف.

6ba82f5e0bc82da0.description: About the Role Unilever is seeking an Assistant Factory Cost Controller to join their team in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role focuses on ensuring operational excellence through accurate factory cost accounting, robust financial controls, and actionable cost insights. The successful candidate will contribute to month-end closing processes, inventory and fixed-asset governance, management reporting, savings tracking, and cost improvement initiatives across the BUL factory. Key Responsibilities Track, analyze, and control manufacturing costs, including raw and packaging materials, labor, utilities, overheads, depreciation, and other production-related expenses. Perform detailed analysis of actual versus standard and budgeted costs, identify key cost drivers and variances, investigate root causes, and ensure accurate allocation of manufacturing costs. Develop and maintain factory and manufacturing budgets in collaboration with production, engineering, and other relevant functions. Partner with cross-functional teams to identify, quantify, and track cost-saving initiatives across materials, production processes, utilities, waste, labor, and factory overheads. Prepare regular production financial reports and performance analysis for management. Deliver accurate and timely month-end cost accounting, including allocations, charge-outs, reclassifications, accruals, and write-offs with complete support. Monitor AUC balances and CAPEX projects, ensuring timely asset capitalization and accurate asset accounting. Ensure compliance with accounting standards and internal control procedures. Support standard costing, inventory valuation, material consumption analysis, stock adjustments, and related controls to ensure accurate product costing and financial reporting. Work closely with production and finance teams to align cost control efforts with overall company objectives. Build business cases for projects by analyzing costs, benefits, and potential risks to support investment decisions. Experience and Qualifications Candidates should possess 2-5 years of relevant experience in a similar financial or cost control role. This position requires a professional who can manage complex financial data and contribute to strategic cost optimization efforts within a manufacturing environment. Work Environment This role is based at the Unilever factory in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. The Assistant Factory Cost Controller will be part of a team committed to impactful work, contributing to both business objectives and broader sustainability goals.

6ba9f47f64d6036c.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة حامد سعود العتيبي للمقاولات عن فني صيانة أجهزة إلكترونية للانضمام إلى فريقها في عرعر، الحدود الشمالية. يركز هذا الدور على تشخيص وصيانة الأجهزة والمعدات الإلكترونية، بالإضافة إلى متابعة برامج الصيانة الوقائية لضمان استمرارية الأداء. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تتبع المخططات الإلكترونية للمنظومات والتمديدات والأجهزة والمعدات الإلكترونية، وتحديد إجراءات تشخيص الأعطال. تشخيص أعطال المنظومات والتمديدات والأجهزة والمعدات الإلكترونية، وتقدير كمية وتكلفة مواد ومستلزمات الصيانة ومتابعة توفيرها. متابعة إجراءات إصلاح الأعطال وفحص الأجهزة والمعدات بعد الإصلاح للتأكد من دقة أدائها وضبطها. متابعة تنفيذ برامج الصيانة الوقائية للمنظومات والتمديدات والأجهزة والمعدات الإلكترونية وفقاً للخطط المحددة. إعداد وتقديم وتوثيق وحفظ تقارير العمل المتعلقة بأنشطة الصيانة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح من 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال صيانة الأجهزة الإلكترونية. القدرة على تتبع الأعطال الإلكترونية وتحديد أسبابها بدقة. معرفة جيدة ببرامج الصيانة الوقائية وكيفية تطبيقها. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة عرعر، الحدود الشمالية. سيعمل الفني ضمن فريق متخصص في صيانة المعدات الإلكترونية، مما يتطلب الالتزام بجدول العمل المحدد والتعاون الفعال مع الزملاء. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم الإفصاح عنه خلال عملية المقابلة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذه الفرصة.

6b71b3906c665b7f.description: About AL Etihad Elevators AL Etihad Elevators is a Saudi-based provider of elevator solutions, specializing in installation, maintenance, and modernization services. The company serves residential, commercial, and institutional buildings across Saudi Arabia from its headquarters in Riyadh and through a network of branches. AL Etihad Elevators offers technical expertise and support for new elevator installations, preventive maintenance, corrective repairs, modernization projects, and tailored vertical transportation solutions. The company operates guided by the values of Heritage, Trust, and Progress, focusing on long-term customer relationships and delivering reliable, future-ready elevator solutions. The Opportunity: Digital Marketing Specialist AL Etihad Elevators is seeking a Digital Marketing Specialist to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time, on-site position. The specialist will be responsible for planning, executing, and optimizing digital campaigns to promote the company's services across various online channels. Key Responsibilities Managing social media accounts for AL Etihad Elevators. Creating and publishing digital content across online platforms. Coordinating online advertising campaigns to enhance brand awareness and generate leads. Monitoring web analytics and evaluating campaign performance. Preparing regular reports on digital marketing activities and results. Recommending data-driven improvements for digital marketing strategies. Collaborating with sales and operations teams to ensure consistent messaging, support marketing initiatives, and maintain the company’s online presence in line with brand and business objectives. Work Environment and Location This is an on-site, full-time role based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The Digital Marketing Specialist will work within the company's operational framework, collaborating with internal teams to achieve marketing and business goals.

6baee4126a784cb5.description: About Nestlé Nespresso SA For over 30 years, Nestlé Nespresso SA has developed a coffee system that enables individuals to create barista-quality coffee experiences at home. The company's innovations have redefined coffee enjoyment for millions globally, growing from a foundational idea in Switzerland to a global brand operating in 82 countries. Nespresso integrates sustainability into its operations, aiming for a positive impact from coffee farming to material choices and recycling efforts. The company fosters an inclusive and international work environment, offering opportunities across various functions and regions, including within the broader Nestlé group. Head of Retail Role Overview Nestlé Nespresso SA is seeking a Head of Retail to lead and develop Nespresso sales across its Boutique network in Makkah and Jeddah. This full-time position requires over 10 years of experience and focuses on upholding brand values and international guidelines. The role involves implementing commercial and people management tools to ensure strong sales and profit performance, excellent customer service, and operational efficiency within the retail environment. Key Responsibilities Ensure consistency of the Nespresso Brand and customer experience across all retail channels (Boutiques, Call Centre, e-Commerce, Trade). Support the B2C Commercial Manager in deploying retail elements for an omni-channel B2C business approach. Monitor and improve Boutique service levels to achieve Net Promoter Score and Customer Voice KPIs. Define retail strategy as part of an omni-channel approach to drive sales and profitability through the Boutique Network. Develop activity calendars with commercial and marketing teams and manage product assortment to meet targets. Analyze sales data for retail performance and propose initiatives to drive traffic and sales to boutiques. Ensure boutique operations, maintenance, and safety comply with international guidelines. Drive improvements for operational efficiency in collaboration with other departments. Manage corporate consistency of Visual Merchandising (VM) Guidance and coach leaders on implementation. Conduct regular operational excellence audits, propose corrective actions, and ensure follow-up. Manage Third Parties in line with Nespresso brand purpose, local regulations, and Nestlé standards. Support Boutique Managers in Employee Lifecycle Management and ensure strong management presence through regular visits. Develop commercial, entrepreneurial, and leadership skills for Boutique Management. Promote a positive working environment that encourages teamwork and professionalism. Collaborate with the Market Trainer to address knowledge and development needs. Support retail location strategy, including identifying new locations, relocation, renovation, and pop-up projects. Support contract negotiations with landlords, adhering to international guidelines. Manage boutique projects from initiation to execution, ensuring adherence to budget, schedule, and scope. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in retail management. Demonstrated ability to develop and implement commercial strategies. Experience in people management and organizational development within a retail context. Proficiency in analyzing sales data and identifying market trends. Strong understanding of operational excellence and project management principles. Work Environment and Culture The Head of Retail will operate in a dynamic, inclusive, and international working environment. Nespresso is committed to fostering a culture that supports employee potential and continuous growth. The role is based in Makkah, with responsibilities spanning Jeddah and Makkah, and is a full-time position.

6bf705e6c5479dff.company_name: شركة ياسر احمد العقبي للاستشارات المهنية
6bf705e6c5479dff.description: نبذة عن الوظيفة تبحث مجموعة بن لادن السعودية عن فني مساحة للانضمام إلى فريقها في المنطقة الشرقية، بمدينة الدمام. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تنفيذ أعمال المسح المساحي لمختلف المشاريع الإنشائية، بما في ذلك الأبنية والطرق، بالإضافة إلى إعداد الخرائط والمخططات اللازمة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تنفيذ أعمال المساحة الاستكشافية اللازمة للمشاريع الإنشائية المتنوعة. إعداد المسودات التفصيلية للمنشآت، العوائق، القنوات، والطرق الفرعية. تحديد وتثبيت نقاط الاستناد الرئيسة والفرعية ونقاط الربط. اختيار الأجهزة والأدوات المساحية المناسبة لكل مهمة. تنفيذ أعمال التسوية الطولية والعرضية لشبكات البنية التحتية. إجراء أعمال التسوية الشبكية لمشاريع الأبنية والأراضي. تثبيت مواقع وحدود الأبنية على الأرض بناءً على المخططات. نقل مواقع وحدود الأبنية القائمة وتثبيتها على المخططات. تثبيت مناسيب جميع الأعمال المتعلقة بالمشروع. تثبيت مسارات الطرق وسكك الحديد وتقاطعاتها. توقيع المنحنيات المختلفة وفقاً للمخططات الهندسية. رسم المقاطع العرضية والطولية، المنحنيات الأفقية والرأسية، والمخططات الكنتورية والمساحية المستخدمة في أعمال المساحة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال المساحة أو ما يعادله. القدرة على تنفيذ أعمال المساحة الاستطلاعية والتسوية المساحية. إتقان استخدام الأجهزة والأدوات المساحية المختلفة. القدرة على قراءة وتفسير المخططات الهندسية ورسمها. بيئة العمل تتطلب الوظيفة العمل بدوام كامل في مشاريع مجموعة بن لادن السعودية بالمنطقة الشرقية، وتحديداً في مدينة الدمام. سيعمل فني المساحة ضمن فريق متخصص لدعم المشاريع الإنشائية المتنوعة. معلومات إضافية نوع الوظيفة: دوام كامل. الراتب: غير معلن. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريق مجموعة بن لادن السعودية، يرجى التقديم لهذه الوظيفة في الدمام بالمنطقة الشرقية.

6b150fe2dc36cb67.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة المسار المضيء للشحن البري في جدة عن سمسارة شحن للانضمام إلى فريقها. يهدف هذا الدور إلى ربط أصحاب البضائع والعملاء مع شركات النقل وأصحاب الشاحنات، وتنسيق عمليات النقل البري بكفاءة. يتطلب الدور خبرة واسعة في مجال وساطة الشحن والنقل البري. المسؤوليات الرئيسية العمل كحلقة وصل بين أصحاب البضائع والعملاء من جهة، وشركات النقل وأصحاب الشاحنات من جهة أخرى. تحديد وتوفير الشاحنات المناسبة لمتطلبات الشحن المختلفة. تنسيق جميع جوانب عمليات النقل البري لضمان سلاسة التسليم. إدارة العلاقات مع العملاء وشركات النقل لضمان رضا جميع الأطراف. التفاوض على شروط النقل والعمولات أو هوامش الربح. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة لا تقل عن 10 سنوات في مجال وساطة الشحن والنقل البري. فهم عميق لسوق النقل البري ومتطلباته. القدرة على بناء علاقات مهنية قوية مع العملاء وشركات النقل. مهارات ممتازة في التفاوض والتواصل. تفاصيل الوظيفة نوع الوظيفة: دوام كامل. المدينة: جدة. الراتب الشهري: يتراوح بين 3,750 ريال سعودي و 5,625 ريال سعودي. عن الشركة المسار المضيء للشحن البري هي شركة متخصصة في خدمات الشحن والنقل البري، وتسعى لتقديم حلول لوجستية فعالة لعملائها. تلتزم الشركة بتوفير بيئة عمل احترافية تدعم النمو المهني لموظفيها. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهتمين والذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم لشغل هذه الوظيفة.

6ba266723ce340c6.description: About the Role Unified Asset & Property Management (UAPM) is seeking a Retail Delivery Engineer to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves the on-site supervision of tenant fit-out projects, minor construction works, and retail delivery activities across URED's managed properties. The Retail Delivery Engineer ensures that all works are executed safely, adhere to approved drawings and specifications, and meet programme and quality requirements, supporting the Manager – Retail Delivery in achieving opening standards for projects. Key Responsibilities Supervise daily on-site activities for tenant fit-outs, refurbishments, and retail delivery projects. Inspect works at key milestones against approved drawings, specifications, and URED's quality standards. Identify and document snags, non-conforming works, and safety violations, issuing formal non-compliance notices as required. Enforce URED's fit-out rules, including working hours, noise curfews, and waste management requirements. Control contractor and tenant access to site, verifying permits, insurances, and method statements before allowing works to proceed. Maintain daily site diaries, recording contractor attendance, works completed, and issues raised. Coordinate utilities connections (power, water, drainage) for fit-out activities with the engineering team. Manage site safety, including hard hat compliance, signage, segregation, and fire risk controls. Monitor individual tenant fit-out programmes and report progress against target dates to the Manager – Retail Delivery. Identify delays, constraints, and risks to the programme, advising management on mitigation options. Prepare weekly site supervision reports and photograph evidence packs for management review. Serve as the primary on-site URED contact for tenants and their fit-out contractors. Manage day-to-day contractor queries, instructions, and site coordination issues. Facilitate pre-start meetings with incoming tenant contractors to review site rules and access procedures. Experience and Qualifications Candidates should possess 2-5 years of relevant experience in site supervision, retail delivery, or construction project management. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, requiring regular on-site presence to oversee project activities and ensure compliance with operational standards.

6baca45fff16dd07.description: About the Role Alturki Holding is seeking a Senior Internal Auditor to join its Internal Audit function in Al Khobar, Eastern Region. This full-time role reports to the Internal Audit Manager and is responsible for executing internal audit engagements to evaluate the design and effectiveness of internal controls across Alturki Holding’s group of companies. The Senior Internal Auditor ensures controls mitigate risks, support regulatory compliance, and enhance operational efficiency and governance practices. Key Responsibilities Define audit engagement objectives and scope, aligning with organizational priorities and audit standards. Identify key risks and controls within business and operational processes under review. Develop comprehensive, risk-based audit programs tailored to specific engagement requirements. Communicate effectively with audit clients, discussing concerns, drafting field memorandums, and updating on engagement progress. Execute audit procedures in accordance with company policies, internal audit methodology, and Global Internal Audit Standards (GIAS). Prepare detailed audit reports, presenting findings and actionable recommendations. Deliver opening and closing presentations to client management to communicate audit scope, findings, and agreed-upon actions. Plan, manage, and execute scheduled audit assignments, ensuring timely and high-quality deliverables. Conduct interviews, document reviews, and process walkthroughs to identify and document internal audit issues. Gather, analyze, and appraise evidence to form objective opinions on the adequacy and effectiveness of internal controls and operational efficiency. Perform tests of controls, analytical reviews, and substantive testing, drawing conclusions based on data and samples. Discuss and reach agreement with clients on internal audit findings and recommendations, providing guidance on practical improvements. Draft high-impact reports, communicating audit results clearly through both written and oral presentations. Conduct follow-up reviews to monitor the status of audit points and assess the effectiveness of corrective actions taken. Ensure all audit results and supporting documentation are accurately recorded and retained in line with company policies, internal audit manual, and GIAS. Perform special investigations and ad-hoc assignments as directed, ensuring timely and thorough resolution. Deliver assurance and consulting services related to internal controls, as directed by the Internal Audit Manager. Stay informed on industry trends, emerging risks, and regulatory developments, integrating these into audit planning and execution where applicable. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor’s degree in accountancy, finance, or a related field. 7 years of internal audit experience. Certification as CIA, CPA, CA, or ACCA is required. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Al Khobar, Eastern Region, within the Internal Audit function of Alturki Holding.

6bd212acb849725b.description: About Calo Inc Calo Inc, launched in Bahrain in November 2019, is dedicated to making healthy eating accessible. The company focuses on providing efficient and affordable food access through technology. This full-time position for an Assistant Quality Manager is based in Riyadh and is open to Saudi Nationals Only. Role Overview The Assistant Quality Manager will support the implementation, monitoring, and continuous improvement of Calo Inc's food safety and quality management systems. This role is critical in ensuring that products, processes, and kitchen operations consistently meet regulatory requirements, customer specifications, and company standards. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in food safety and quality assurance within the food and beverage industry. Key Responsibilities Support the implementation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of the company's Food Safety and Quality Management System, including HACCP, GMPs, SOPs, and relevant standards such as ISO 22000 and FSSC 22000. Ensure day-to-day kitchen and production operations comply with established food safety procedures, quality standards, and applicable local regulations. Monitor compliance with food safety and quality policies, identifying gaps and recommending improvements where necessary. Support the development, review, and implementation of food safety procedures, work instructions, and quality control processes. Required Activities Conduct routine internal audits and inspections to assess compliance with food safety, hygiene, and quality standards. Support preparations for regulatory, certification, and third-party audits, ensuring the required documentation and records are maintained. Identify non-conformances, investigate underlying causes, and follow up on corrective and preventive action plans to ensure timely closure. Monitor compliance with applicable local and international food safety regulations, including relevant SFDA requirements where applicable. Candidate Profile The ideal candidate will possess a strong background in food safety and quality assurance within the food and beverage industry. Experience in central kitchen or large-scale food production operations is preferred. Candidates should be proficient in conducting audits, investigating quality issues, implementing corrective actions, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to maintain high standards of food safety and product quality. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role involves working closely with various teams to ensure adherence to food safety and quality standards across all operations.

6b6ffdc08130b95c.company_name: مؤسسة خالد عبيد درويش الرشيدي للنقليات
6b6ffdc08130b95c.description: تعلن الشركة عن رغبتها في استقطاب مشرف علاقات حكومية للانضمام إلى فريق العمل، على أن يكون لديه الخبرة والكفاءة في إدارة ومتابعة المعاملات الحكومية والإشراف على الإجراءات ذات العلاقة بالمنشأة وموظفيها. المهام والمسؤوليات: الإشراف على جميع المعاملات والإجراءات الحكومية الخاصة بالمنشأة ومتابعة إنجازها في الوقت المحدد. متابعة إصدار وتجديد الإقامات ورخص العمل والتأشيرات والتراخيص والتصاريح الحكومية. إدارة ومتابعة المنصات الحكومية الإلكترونية ذات العلاقة بنشاط المنشأة. متابعة تواريخ انتهاء الوثائق والتراخيص والتأكد من تجديدها قبل انتهائها. التنسيق مع الجهات الحكومية لمعالجة الملاحظات والمعوقات المتعلقة بالمعاملات. متابعة المخالفات والغرامات الحكومية والعمل على معالجتها بالتنسيق مع الإدارات المعنية. الإشراف على فريق العلاقات الحكومية وتوزيع المهام ومتابعة الأداء. إعداد التقارير الدورية المتعلقة بالمعاملات الحكومية ومستوى الإنجاز. التنسيق مع إدارات الموارد البشرية والشؤون المالية والإدارات الأخرى لضمان استكمال الإجراءات المطلوبة. ضمان الالتزام بالأنظمة والتعليمات الحكومية والمحافظة على سرية المستندات والبيانات. المتطلبات والمؤهلات: بكالوريوس في إدارة الأعمال أو تخصص ذي صلة. خبرة عملية من 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال العلاقات الحكومية. خبرة في استخدام المنصات الحكومية الإلكترونية ذات الصلة. إجادة استخدام الحاسب الآلي وبرامج Microsoft Office. لغة انجليزية جيدة.

6bbaf459a8edd6dc.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة صفوة المهيدب لطب الاسنان عن طبيب اخصائي للانضمام إلى فريقها في الزلفي، الرياض. يركز هذا الدور على دراسة وتشخيص الحالات المرضية ضمن مجال التخصص، ووضع الخطط العلاجية ومتابعة تنفيذها، بالإضافة إلى تقييم تطور الحالات وفعالية العلاج. المسؤوليات الرئيسية أخذ السيرة المرضية الشاملة من المريض وذويه لجمع المعلومات اللازمة. دراسة الحالة المرضية بدقة وإجراء الفحص السريري اللازم لتحديد طبيعة المشكلة. طلب الفحوصات والتحاليل المخبرية، بالإضافة إلى الصور الشعاعية أو الصوتية أو الموجية عند الحاجة. قراءة النتائج والتقارير الطبية لتشخيص الحالة المرضية ضمن مجال التخصص. وضع خطة علاجية متكاملة ومتابعة تنفيذها لضمان أفضل النتائج للمريض. تقييم تطور الحالة المرضية وفاعلية الخطة العلاجية بشكل دوري. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير الطبية المتعلقة بالمريض وحفظها بشكل منظم ودقيق. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال التخصص الطبي. القدرة على تشخيص الحالات المرضية بدقة ووضع خطط علاجية فعالة. مهارات تواصل ممتازة مع المرضى وذويهم. نوع الوظيفة هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل، مما يتطلب التزامًا كاملاً بالمهام والمسؤوليات المحددة. موقع العمل يقع مقر العمل في مدينة الزلفي ضمن منطقة الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن وسيتم مناقشته خلال مراحل التوظيف.

6b195b8bc0805ff4.company_name: Qiddiya Investment Company | شركة قدية الاستثمارية
6b195b8bc0805ff4.description: About Qiddiya Qiddiya, located in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, is seeking a Senior Manager of Operational Readiness DA. This full-time role involves providing strategic leadership for operational readiness across major assets and programs within Qiddiya's entertainment and cultural projects. The position focuses on ensuring a controlled transition from project delivery into safe, compliant, and sustainable operations. Role Purpose The Senior Manager Operational Readiness DA will establish readiness direction, govern assurance and activation recommendations, and align senior stakeholders on priorities, risks, and outcomes. This is critical for supporting seamless launches, sustained operations, and exceptional guest experiences across Qiddiya's diverse projects. Core Responsibilities Define and implement operational readiness strategy, governance, standards, assurance methodology, and activation decision gates for assigned portfolios, aligning with Qiddiya's strategic objectives. Lead integrated readiness planning and delivery across various workstreams including people, process, technology, facilities, safety, security, commercial, regulatory, and service, with sequenced plans and accountable owners. Provide senior oversight of milestones, interdependencies, risks, issues, decisions, and evidence-based completion status; establish and monitor readiness and operational performance KPIs. Collaborate with project delivery, operations, engineering, and stakeholder teams to embed operational requirements throughout design, procurement, commissioning, handover, mobilization, and opening plans. Chair senior readiness reviews, resolve cross-workstream dependencies, and direct mitigation and recovery plans for gaps affecting safety, compliance, guest experience, or activation dates. Advise executive leadership on readiness status, activation options, residual risks, performance findings, and required decisions, escalating trade-offs beyond delegated authority. Specific Duties Oversee operating-model, workforce, standard operating procedure (SOP), operating supplies and equipment (OS&E), technology, facilities, and service mobilization readiness; ensure staff training and development prepare operational teams to meet defined performance standards. Govern readiness for permits, licenses, and regulatory interfaces through accountable functions, ensuring clear ownership, timely delivery, and visibility of unresolved compliance gaps. Lead readiness assessments, assurance reviews, inspections, rehearsals, and operational trials; recommend progression through key stage gates based on completion evidence and clearly stated residual risks. Oversee consultants, contractors, advisers, and operators supporting readiness, ensuring clear scope, deliverable quality, schedule, and accountability. Build team capability through direction, coaching, performance management, and consistent quality standards. Champion a guest-focused approach and continuous improvement, applying lessons learned, best practices, and industry standards to improve readiness plans and standardize delivery across the function. Qualifications and Experience Candidates should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience. Ability to follow applicable company policies, safety requirements, confidentiality, and document-control practices. Maintain clear records and perform related duties consistent with the approved role scope. Work within approved delegated authorities; recommend activation decisions to authorized decision-makers. Application Information This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Salary details will be disclosed during the recruitment process.

6bddf5ea1f8b180d.description: About the Role The National Medical Care Company (Care) is seeking a Senior Registrar Orthopedic Surgeon for a full-time position in Riyadh. This role involves providing comprehensive care to inpatient orthopedic patients, ensuring high professional standards, and adhering to medical ethics, JCIA standards, hospital by-laws, and Ministry of Health regulations in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Key Responsibilities Ensure high-quality medical treatment, compassion, and understanding for all patients at NMC Hospitals and Clinics. Perform history taking, physical examinations, and interpret diagnostic tests, documenting patient conditions upon admission as per JCIA standards or as advised by the Head of Department (HOD). Admit emergency and elective cases within determined privileges, in consultation with a consultant. Evaluate new admissions and coordinate investigation plans to establish diagnoses and management courses, with or without consultant assistance as determined by HOD. Conduct daily ward rounds for all inpatients, independently or as part of a team. Document patient management plans and maintain accurate, timely, and legible medical records, including updated follow-up notes. Seek consultant advice for complex patient conditions, working under the supervision of the assigned consultant. Prepare discharge summaries, death reports, and special patient reports, especially when a registrar is unavailable. Assess and refer appropriate patients to other medical facilities and accept referrals within the specialty. Present new admissions during daily morning reports when on duty and a registrar is unavailable. Uphold patients’ rights to security, confidentiality, and privacy. Participate actively in the department's on-call rota for patient care and admissions. Respond to emergencies to provide medical care and advice related to the specialty. Participate in outpatient department (OPD) medical care, independently or as determined by HOD. Assist senior staff (Consultants) in performing diagnostic or therapeutic procedures. Perform diagnostic and therapeutic procedures independently within operative privileges. Supervise junior staff in their duties as designated by the department. Actively participate in departmental educational and training activities. Adhere to department policies and procedures, hospital by-laws, rules, and regulations. Perform other assigned tasks within the scope of knowledge, skills, and abilities. Educate patients and families according to their needs, involving them in the plan of care and respecting their goals and choices, with appropriate documentation. Reporting Structure and Supervision The Senior Registrar Orthopedic Surgeon reports directly to the Consultant Orthopedic Surgeon and the Head of the Department of Surgery. This role involves supervising Registrars, Residents, Nurses, and other assigned paramedical staff. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 3 years of relevant experience is required. Demonstrated knowledge of patient and family education processes and the ability to provide health promotion and teaching appropriate to patient needs and preferences.

6b4af81ae60855e5.description: أن يكون المتقدم سعودي الجنسية. حاصل على درجة البكالوريوس في تخصص السمعيات أو علوم السمع. حاصل على تصنيف وتسجيل مهني ساري المفعول من الهيئة السعودية للتخصصات الصحية. إجادة إجراء فحوصات السمع وتقييم الحالات. القدرة على برمجة وضبط السماعات الطبية ومتابعة المرضى. مهارات تواصل جيدة والقدرة على العمل ضمن فريق. سمع (Pure Tone Audiometry – PTA). معرفة باختبارات الكلام وقياس طبلة الأذن (Speech Audiometry & Tympanometry). القدرة على تقييم احتياجات ضعاف السمع. معرفة ببرمجة وضبط السماعات الطبية (Hearing Aid Fitting & Programming). معرفة بأخذ طبعات الأذن للقوالب الطبية (Ear Impressions). القدرة على شرح استخدام السماعات الطبية وتقديم الإرشادات للعملاء. مهارات جيدة في التواصل وخدمة العملاء. إجادة استخدام الحاسب الآلي وإعداد التقارير

6b92316fc1349fe7.description: تبحث شركتنا عن مندوب مبيعات طموح للانضمام إلى فريقنا المتنامي. ستكون مسؤولاً عن تحقيق أهداف المبيعات، وتوسيع قاعدة العملاء، وتقديم تجربة عملاء استثنائية. إذا كنت تمتلك مهارات تواصل قوية وشغفًا بالمبيعات، فنحن ندعوك للتقديم. المهام والمسؤوليات: * تحديد وتنمية فرص المبيعات الجديدة. * بناء علاقات قوية مع العملاء الحاليين والمحتملين. * تحقيق أهداف المبيعات المحددة وتقديم تقارير دورية. * تقديم عروض تقديمية فعالة للمنتجات والخدمات. * التعامل مع استفسارات العملاء وحل مشكلاتهم بكفاءة. المهارات المطلوبة : * خبرة بالعمل الميداني وشخصية قوية مع العملاء * قدرة على التفاوض وانهاء الصفقات مع العملاء المحتملين * القدرة على استكشاف عملاء جدد * خبرة بمجال المقاولات والمكاتب الهندسية والتعامل معهم مجال عمل الشركة: * انظمة الواجهات الزجاجية * انظمة المظلات المتحركه الكهربائية والواجهات المحتركه * أنظمة الoutdoor الذكيه * انظمة النوافذ والأبواب للفلل

6bdb3e17e49ebbbc.description: About The Role About Us Soar is a Saudi fintech startup that specializes in financing and investment. Headquartered in Saudi Arabia and growing throughout the region, Soar’s mission is to help people achieve their financial goals with innovative financial and property investment solutions and tools, delivered through a multi-purpose platform designed for a simple and seamless user experience. The Mission Real estate is one of the largest, slowest-to-change markets on earth. Trillions of dollars in transactions still run on fragmented data, manual workflows, and software that automates paperwork instead of doing the work. We believe that era is over. At Soar, we are building an agentic-first platform: products where AI agents don’t just assist people, they do the work (sourcing, analyzing, negotiating, coordinating, and closing), with humans setting direction and judgment. We are looking for a Head of Product to turn that vision into products people use every day. You will own a core product area end to end, from discovery to launch to scale, and lead the team that builds it. This is not a role for someone who wants to manage a backlog. It is for a builder who wants to ship the first agentic products in a category that doesn’t exist yet. What “agentic-first” means here Most companies are bolting a chatbot onto legacy software. We are doing the opposite: designing the product around autonomous and semi-autonomous agents as the primary way work gets done, with interfaces, data, and trust models built to match. As Head of Product, you will put this thesis into practice: Agents as the core unit of the product, rather than features that wrap a model around old workflows. Outcomes over interfaces. The product should accomplish outcomes, not just surface information. Trust, transparency, and human-in-the-loop by design. Design for the moments where the agent acts on the user’s behalf, and where the human stays in control. Data and feedback as a moat. Build a learning loop where every transaction makes the next one smarter. What you’ll do Own the roadmap. Translate the company’s product vision and strategy into a clear roadmap for your area, with priorities you can defend and adjust as you learn. Ship 0 to 1, then 1 to n. Define the first wedge, take it from blank page to launch, and iterate quickly based on real usage. Lead and grow the team. Hire, coach, and lead product managers and designers, and build a culture of speed, ownership, and craft. Go hands-on with the technology. Work directly with frontier models, agent frameworks, and emerging tooling. Prototype, write specs and prompts, and run experiments to find what works. Make calls under uncertainty. Make fast, well-reasoned decisions with incomplete information, and own the results. Work across the company. Partner closely with engineering, design, data, GTM, and leadership to get the right things built and launched well. Stay obsessed with users. Talk to agents, brokers, buyers, sellers, and investors constantly. Turn the messy reality of real estate into products people love. Requirements Who you are A proven builder. You have shipped products that real people used, ideally including 0-to-1 work where you helped define the problem, not just the solution. Creative and unconventional. You think from first principles, question defaults, and enjoy problems with no established playbook. Fluent in applied AI. You’ve worked with LLMs, agents, or applied AI in production, or gone deep enough to lead a team that does. Execution-focused. You turn strategy into shipped product, set clear goals and metrics, and keep a team moving at high velocity. Strategic and hands-on. You can shape strategy for your area and dive into the details: prototypes, specs, prompts, data, and metrics. A strong people leader. You attract great PMs and designers, help them do their best work, and raise the bar around you. Clear and fast. You move with urgency, communicate with clarity, and care more about impact than process. Bonus points Experience in fintech, marketplaces, agentic applications, or AI research and R&D. Startup or early-stage operator experience. A technical background, or the ability to go toe-to-toe with engineers on agent architecture. A portfolio of products, prototypes, or experiments we can see and play with. Why this role You will be a core member of the product leadership team, with real ownership over what gets built and how. You’ll work alongside the CPO and leadership to shape the product and the team from the early days. The market is enormous, the timing for agentic AI is now, and the upside, in impact and in equity, is real. If you want to build products that change an entire industry, and you’re ready to move fast to do it, we should talk. (edited)

6b78c7b0ecf1f71d.description: About Boehringer Ingelheim Boehringer Ingelheim operates within the IMETA Regional Operating Unit, which encompasses six mid-sized Operating Units: India, Turkey, Southern Africa (South Africa & Sub Sahara Africa), Northeast & West Africa, Near East & UAE, Saudi Arabia, Gulf & East Africa (SAGEA). This diverse region is home to over 47 nationalities, fostering a collaborative environment focused on talent development and retention. The Role Boehringer Ingelheim is seeking a Sales and Marketing Coordinator for a 12-month fixed-term contract, based in Riyadh. This role will be engaged through a third-party outsourcing partner and will report to the Head of Business Unit. The Sales and Marketing Coordinator will provide essential support to the Marketing, Sales, and Market Access teams, ensuring efficient coordination of events, financial processes, promotional materials, and compliance with company policies. This position requires strong organizational, communication, and analytical skills to manage diverse responsibilities effectively while maintaining attention to detail. Key Responsibilities Manage the end-to-end event planning process, including documentation, approvals, execution, and reconciliation, ensuring compliance with company policies. Coordinate travel, accommodation, and visa requirements for Boehringer Ingelheim employees, patient organizations, payers, and Healthcare Professionals (HCPs) attending company-sponsored events. Facilitate purchasing, payment processes, and financial reporting for Marketing, Sales, and Market Access activities. Monitor budgets, track expenses, process purchase orders (POs), and ensure accurate and transparent financial reporting. Collaborate with finance teams to consolidate reports and maintain cost control. Liaise with suppliers for the production, supply, and distribution of promotional materials. Oversee stock management systems to ensure optimal inventory levels and efficient utilization of materials. Serve as the primary point of contact for external vendors, handling communications, quotations, and procurement processes. Ensure adherence to Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and compliance with company policies in all marketing and procurement activities. Identify and implement process improvements to enhance efficiency and cost-effectiveness. Qualifications and Experience 0-1 year of relevant experience. Strong organizational skills. Effective communication skills. Analytical capabilities. Ability to manage multiple responsibilities and maintain attention to detail. Application Process Interested candidates are invited to submit their applications. Following a review of your CV, suitable candidates will be invited for a screening interview. Boehringer Ingelheim conducts Sanctioned Party List (SPL) screenings for all business relations, including job applicants, to comply with applicable export control laws. This process may involve the processing of personal data in relevant databases, including those of third-party vendors, which may be located or accessible outside the EU. Boehringer Ingelheim is committed to ensuring an adequate level of protection for your personal data.

6b7730a3db447614.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة اسياف التطوير للمقاولات عن فني ميكانيكي تمديدات صحية وتدفئة وغاز للانضمام إلى فريقها في الباحة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على إعداد قوائم المواد والمعدات اللازمة لأعمال التمديدات، ومتابعة التنفيذ، بالإضافة إلى تشخيص أعطال المعدات الميكانيكية وصيانتها. المسؤوليات الرئيسية يتولى شاغل الوظيفة مجموعة من المهام الأساسية لضمان سير عمل مشاريع التمديدات والصيانة بكفاءة، وتشمل هذه المسؤوليات ما يلي: إعداد قوائم مفصلة ببنود القطع والمواد والمعدات المطلوبة لتنفيذ أعمال التمديدات الصحية والتدفئة المركزية وشبكات الغاز. متابعة تنفيذ أعمال شبكات أنابيب التمديدات الصحية والتدفئة المركزية وشبكات الغاز لضمان مطابقتها للمواصفات. تشخيص أعطال المعدات الميكانيكية بدقة ومتابعة عمليات إصلاحها لضمان استمرارية العمل. متابعة تنفيذ برامج الصيانة الوقائية للمعدات لتقليل الأعطال وتحسين الأداء. الالتزام بسياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة المعتمدة في جميع مراحل العمل. المؤهلات والخبرة يتطلب هذا الدور خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة، مما يجعله فرصة مناسبة للمرشحين الجدد أو ذوي الخبرة المحدودة الذين يسعون لتطوير مهاراتهم في قطاع المقاولات. بيئة العمل يعمل الفني بدوام كامل ضمن فريق شركة اسياف التطوير للمقاولات في منطقة الباحة، حيث يساهم في تنفيذ مشاريع الشركة المتنوعة. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور سيتم تحديده ومناقشته خلال المقابلة الشخصية. التقديم ندعو المهتمين ممن تنطبق عليهم المتطلبات للتقديم على هذا الدور في الباحة.

6bb0016a72ad6168.job_title: Director of Commercial - Sofitel Jabal Omar Makkah
6bb0016a72ad6168.description: Job description Company Description "Why work for Accor? We are far more than a worldwide leader. We welcome you as you are and you can find a job and brand that matches your personality. We support you to grow and learn every day, making sure that work brings purpose to your life, so that during your journey with us, you can continue to explore Accor’s limitless possibilities. By joining Accor, every chapter of your story is yours to write and together we can imagine tomorrow's hospitality. Discover the life that awaits you at Accor, visit https://careers.accor.com/ Do what you love, care for the world, dare to challenge the status quo! #BELIMITLESS" Job Description Reporting to the General Manager, the Director of Commercial is responsible for leading the overall commercial strategy of Sofitel Jabal Omar Makkah, driving sustainable revenue growth, market share, profitability and brand positioning across all business segments. As a key member of the Executive Committee, this role provides strategic leadership across Sales, Revenue Management, Marketing, Digital & Communications, Distribution, Reservations and Business Development, ensuring all commercial disciplines operate under one integrated strategy. Working closely with Operations, Finance and Regional Commercial teams, the Director of Commercial develops and executes revenue-generating initiatives that maximize performance across Rooms, Restaurants, Wellness, Meetings & Events and ancillary revenue streams, while strengthening the hotel's position as one of the leading luxury hospitality destinations in Makkah. Acting as both a commercial strategist and brand ambassador, the Director ensures that every commercial initiative reflects the elegance of the Sofitel brand while respecting the cultural and religious significance of the destination. Key Responsibilities, among others; Commercial Strategy & Business Planning: Develop and execute the hotel's overall commercial strategy aligned with business objectives, market conditions and brand standards. Lead the annual commercial planning process including budgeting, forecasting and business plans. Identify new revenue opportunities across all business segments and distribution channels. Establish short, medium and long-term commercial priorities to maximise profitability and market share. Collaborate closely with Operations and Finance to align commercial initiatives with operational capabilities and financial objectives. Monitor market dynamics, competitor activity, demand patterns and industry trends to identify strategic opportunities. Sales Leadership: Lead the Sales function across all market segments including Corporate, Leisure, Wholesale, Government, Luxury Travel, Groups and MICE. Develop strategic sales plans to maximise business from domestic, regional and international markets. Strengthen relationships with key corporate accounts, travel partners, luxury consortia, government entities and tourism stakeholders. Drive proactive business development and account acquisition strategies. Ensure effective sales activities including prospecting, account management, sales missions and client events. Monitor sales performance through defined KPIs and ensure achievement of revenue targets. Revenue Management & Distribution: Provide strategic oversight of Revenue Management to maximise RevPAR, ADR and occupancy. Ensure pricing strategies remain dynamic, competitive and aligned with market demand. Lead weekly commercial and revenue strategy meetings. Optimise channel mix across direct and indirect distribution. Oversee inventory management, segmentation strategies and demand forecasting. Ensure effective management of distribution channels including Brand.com, GDS, OTAs, wholesalers and strategic partners. Continuously identify opportunities to improve profitability through pricing optimisation and revenue management practices. Marketing, Digital & Brand Positioning: Oversee the integrated Marketing, Digital and Communications strategy to strengthen brand awareness, market positioning and commercial performance. Ensure marketing initiatives support revenue objectives across Rooms, F&B, Wellness and ancillary outlets. Champion the hotel's Cultural Link and brand storytelling across all guest touchpoints. Support strategic partnerships, PR initiatives, digital campaigns and luxury brand collaborations. Ensure digital marketing investments generate measurable commercial returns. E-Commerce & Distribution Performance: Drive growth across all digital channels, ensuring strong direct booking performance. Oversee website performance, booking engine optimisation and digital conversion strategies. Support CRM initiatives and guest lifecycle marketing. Monitor digital analytics, campaign performance and customer acquisition costs. Ensure effective collaboration between Revenue, Marketing and Distribution teams. Commercial Performance & Analytics: Monitor commercial performance through key metrics including Revenue, RevPAR, ADR, Occupancy, Market Share, GOP contribution and channel profitability. Analyse market intelligence and competitor performance to support strategic decision-making. Prepare regular commercial performance reports for the General Manager, Executive Committee and Regional Commercial teams. Develop action plans to address business gaps and capitalise on emerging opportunities. Ensure data-driven decision making across all commercial disciplines. Cross-Functional Leadership: Serve as a strategic advisor to the General Manager on all commercial matters. Foster strong collaboration between Commercial, Operations, Finance and Talent & Culture. Ensure seamless communication between Sales, Revenue Management, Marketing and Reservations. Drive a culture of accountability, innovation and continuous improvement. Lead commercial projects supporting hotel openings, renovations and strategic initiatives where applicable. Leadership & Talent Development: Lead, coach and develop a high-performing Commercial team. Create an environment that promotes collaboration, innovation and performance excellence. Identify and develop future commercial talent through coaching, mentoring and succession planning. Establish clear objectives and performance expectations across all commercial disciplines. Champion Sofitel's culture, values and luxury service philosophy. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in hospitality management, Business Administration, Marketing or a related field. Minimum 10 years' experience in commercial leadership within luxury hospitality. Proven experience leading integrated commercial functions including Sales, Revenue Management and Marketing. Strong understanding of luxury hospitality, distribution, pricing strategy and revenue optimisation. Demonstrated ability to deliver sustainable revenue growth and market share improvements. Strong financial and commercial acumen. Excellent analytical and strategic planning skills. Strong leadership, negotiation and stakeholder management capabilities. Experience working within an international luxury hotel brand. Fluent in English and Arabic. Additional Information Our commitment to Diversity & Inclusion: We are an inclusive company and our ambition is to attract, recruit and promote diverse talent. Preferred candidate Years of experience 5+ years Degree Bachelor's degree / higher diploma

6bcce3e90b0b951a.description: Job description Company Description About Veolia Veolia aims to be the benchmark company for ecological transformation . Our mission to “ Resource the world ” demonstrates the unwavering commitment of our 220,000 employees to creating a positive impact for our planet. By joining Veolia Water Technologies, not only will you become a Resourcer, but you will also take part in providing complete solutions for water treatment. By innovating in key areas such as sustainable development, resource and product recovery, we want to offer water related solutions suited for every application. At Veolia Water Technologies, Saudi Arabia , we are committed to empowering our employees, to make their own decisions and to make a real difference. Become a player in ecological transformation by joining us! Conducts site visits and technical assessments to understand temporary water treatment requirements, emergency needs, and operational challenges; works closely with clients and internal technical teams to define suitable mobile water solutions. 6b346992bfe8c4ff.company_name: مستشفى الدكتور سمير محمد علي عباس
6b346992bfe8c4ff.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة رفاء الطبية عن أخصائي تمريض للانضمام إلى فريقها في المنطقة الشرقية، بمدينة الخبر. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تقديم رعاية تمريضية شاملة للمرضى، بدءًا من التقييم وحتى تنفيذ خطط الرعاية ومتابعتها. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تقييم الوضع الصحي للمريض، وجمع البيانات من المريض وذويه، وتوثيقها وتحليلها لتحديد احتياجات الرعاية. إعداد خطة الرعاية التمريضية، ومتابعة تنفيذها، وتقييم نتائجها لضمان أفضل مستويات الرعاية. أخذ العلامات الحيوية للمريض وعينات الدم والبول والبراز لإجراء الفحوصات المخبرية وفقًا لتعليمات الطبيب المعالج، ومتابعة إرسالها للمختبر والحصول على النتائج وإعلام الطبيب. إعطاء الأدوية والعقاقير الطبية والمحاليل الوريدية بحسب تعليمات الطبيب المعالج، والمشاركة في عملية الإنعاش القلبي والرئوي عند الحاجة. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات في أساليب التمريض والرعاية التمريضية لضمان تقديم خدمة حديثة وفعالة. توثيق الإجراءات والأنشطة التمريضية المقدمة للمريض في السجل الطبي، وضمان تطبيق مبادئ وقواعد السلامة العامة أثناء القيام بمختلف أعمال وعمليات التمريض. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في مجال التمريض. القدرة على تقييم الحالات الصحية بدقة ووضع خطط رعاية فعالة. مهارات تواصل ممتازة مع المرضى وذويهم والفريق الطبي. بيئة العمل يعمل أخصائي التمريض ضمن فريق طبي متكامل في شركة رفاء الطبية، في بيئة عمل داعمة تهدف إلى تقديم أفضل رعاية صحية للمرضى في المنطقة الشرقية، الخبر. الوظيفة بدوام كامل. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور.

6b509ac27a0df88b.description: About Americana Restaurants Americana Restaurants operates a portfolio of global brands across the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, including KFC, Hardee's, Pizza Hut, Krispy Kreme, TGI Fridays, and Peet's Coffee. The company is expanding its Occupational Health & Safety team and is seeking Saudi national talent for positions in the Central, Eastern, and Western regions. The Role of Health and Safety Associate The Health and Safety Associate will contribute to maintaining a safe working environment across Americana Restaurants' operations. This full-time role involves implementing and overseeing health and safety protocols, conducting assessments, and ensuring compliance with regulatory standards. The position is based in Riyadh, Dammam, Al Khobar, or Jeddah. Key Responsibilities Conduct risk assessments across restaurants and facilities. Ensure methods and systems of work are safe, documented, and applied effectively. Verify that contractors and aggregators are competent and hold required licenses and certificates. Execute the documented OH&S audit program and follow corrective and preventive actions to closure. Track OH&S metrics and utilize data for risk identification and reduction. Deliver fire safety, first aid, and other OH&S training, maintaining accurate training records. Train teams on standard operating procedures and emergency response plans for major incidents. Ensure correct fire safety setup, including resources and liaison with designated authorities. Ensure adherence to accident, incident, and near-miss reporting procedures, and support investigations. Maintain accurate incident records and statistics. Liaise with regulatory authorities to ensure compliance. Qualifications and Experience Candidates must be Saudi nationals. A minimum of 5 to 10 years of experience in a relevant field is required. Work Location This position is available in Riyadh, Dammam, Al Khobar, and Jeddah, within the Riyadh region of Saudi Arabia. Application Process Americana Restaurants invites qualified Saudi nationals to apply for this Health and Safety Associate role.

6bae79cf779056c6.description: About the Role JIGPC- Jazan Integrated Gasification and Power Company is seeking an experienced Control Room Operator for its power generation facility in Jazan, Jizan, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves supporting the safe and efficient operation of a world-class power generation plant, utilizing advanced Distributed Control Systems (DCS) platforms to ensure reliable generation, equipment integrity, and operational excellence. Position Purpose The primary purpose of this position is to safely and efficiently operate and monitor power generation systems from the Central Control Room. The operator will use Distributed Control Systems (DCS) to ensure reliable electricity production, plant availability, environmental compliance, and overall operational excellence within the facility. Key Responsibilities Monitor and control plant operations through DCS and associated control systems. Operate Gas Turbines, Steam Turbines, HRSGs, Boilers, Generators, and Balance of Plant equipment according to approved procedures. Optimize unit performance to achieve generation targets while maintaining equipment integrity. Monitor critical operating parameters including temperatures, pressures, flows, emissions, and electrical outputs. Execute normal startup, shutdown, and load adjustment activities. Coordinate unit synchronization, desynchronization, and load dispatch requirements. Support plant commissioning, testing, and operational readiness activities as needed. Respond to grid demands and maintain stable operation during changing load conditions. Identify abnormalities, alarms, and equipment performance deviations, taking immediate corrective actions within authority limits and escalating major issues. Support root cause investigations of plant trips, disturbances, and equipment failures. Lead or participate in emergency response actions during abnormal operating conditions. Ensure strict adherence to HSE policies, operating procedures, and permit-to-work requirements. Maintain compliance with environmental regulations and emission requirements. Participate in operational risk assessments and safety audits. Ensure safe isolation and handover of equipment for maintenance activities. Coordinate effectively with Field Operators, Maintenance Personnel, Shift Supervisors, and Engineering teams. Communicate operational status, constraints, and critical activities during shift handovers. Provide operational guidance to field operators during routine and non-routine activities. Maintain accurate operating logs and shift reports, recording plant events, equipment abnormalities, and operational interventions. Prepare reports relating to operational performance, incidents, and process deviations. Identify opportunities for efficiency improvement and performance optimization. Participate in operational excellence initiatives and procedure enhancements. Support training and mentoring of junior operators when required. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5 to 10 years of experience in a relevant role within power generation or heavy industrial operations. Demonstrated experience operating and monitoring plant systems using Distributed Control Systems (DCS). Proficiency in operating Gas Turbines, Steam Turbines, HRSGs, Boilers, Generators, and Balance of Plant equipment. Strong understanding of operational procedures, safety protocols, and environmental compliance. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Jazan, Jizan, Saudi Arabia, within one of Saudi Arabia's largest power and industrial operations. The role requires working in a central control room environment and coordinating with various operational and maintenance teams. Application Process Candidates who meet the specified qualifications and experience are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

6bb2b84c935c74bb.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة ابراهيم محمد الوهيبي للتجارة والمقاولات العامة عن مهندس مدني للانضمام إلى فريقها في عنيزة، القصيم. يتطلب هذا الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات، وسيكون بدوام كامل. يركز الدور على دراسة المواقع الإنشائية، إعداد التصاميم والمخططات، والإشراف على تنفيذ المشاريع لضمان مطابقتها للمواصفات. المسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة طبوغرافية وجيولوجية الموقع الإنشائي، بالإضافة إلى تحليل نتائج اختبار فحص التربة. دراسة المتطلبات والمخططات المعمارية الخاصة بالمشروع. تحديد أعماق التأسيس اللازمة للمشروع وإجراء تحليل إنشائي متكامل لعناصره. إعداد التصاميم الإنشائية للمشروع ومتابعة إعداد المخططات الإنشائية وتدقيقها. تدقيق جداول الكميات والمواصفات الخاصة بالمواد الإنشائية. الإشراف المباشر على تنفيذ المشروع لضمان مطابقة جميع الأعمال للمواصفات والمعايير المحددة. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات التقنية في المجال الهندسي. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بنتائج الأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية، وتوضيح نسبة تقدمها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات شهادة جامعية في الهندسة المدنية. خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال الهندسة المدنية والمقاولات. معرفة قوية بأسس التصميم الإنشائي وتحليل التربة. القدرة على قراءة وتدقيق المخططات الهندسية وجداول الكميات. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات ممتازة في الإشراف الميداني ومتابعة المشاريع. القدرة على إعداد التقارير الفنية والوثائق المتخصصة. مهارات تواصل فعالة والقدرة على العمل ضمن فريق. الالتزام بالمعايير الهندسية والجودة. بيئة العمل سيعمل المهندس المدني بدوام كامل في مقر الشركة بمدينة عنيزة، القصيم. يتضمن الدور العمل المكتبي والميداني للإشراف على المشاريع الإنشائية. معلومات إضافية الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.
